nodes.label: Empty Docking Canvas Goal
nodes.rationale: BruceDE is a plugin-first desktop workspace, not an IDE with a fixed layout. The initial workspace is an empty full-window docking canvas; no editor, sidebar, terminal, chat, file tree, Git view, or toolbar opens by default.

nodes.label: Full System Access Trust Model
nodes.rationale: All plugins are trusted native code with no sandbox, VM, worker, or subprocess isolation. The plugin manager must warn before installing or enabling third-party plugins and require an explicit trust decision. The warning is disclosure, not a security boundary.

nodes.label: Plugin Loading Flow
nodes.rationale: Discover plugin.json, validate id/version/apiVersion/entrypoints/dependencies, resolve Cordis dependencies, import frontend ESM into the renderer and backend ESM into the Node backend, adapt activate(api) into a Cordis fiber, and dispose everything on disable or uninstall.

nodes.label: Panel Ownership and Disposal
nodes.rationale: Contributions must be registered through disposable effects. On disable or uninstall the host disposes the fiber, unregisters services/events/commands, closes every owned panel instance, and releases watchers, timers, and processes. Closing a panel is not unloading its plugin.

nodes.label: Services and Typed Events
nodes.rationale: Use services for callable capabilities and durable shared state, and typed events for notifications. Cross-plugin data contracts belong in plugin-api; plugins must not import another plugin's implementation.

nodes.label: Theia RPC Boundary
nodes.rationale: Frontend/backend communication crosses Theia's existing RPC boundary; no additional per-plugin process or sandbox is added.

nodes.label: No Prescribed Dock Placement
nodes.rationale: Plugin registration must not prescribe a dock location. Only the user or an explicit user action chooses placement; persist layouts independently of plugin installation.

nodes.label: Independent Layout Persistence
nodes.rationale: Persist user layouts independently of plugin installation, and keep the startup canvas empty unless the user explicitly restores a saved layout.

nodes.label: Build Order Direction
nodes.rationale: Build in order: stable manifest and API contracts; Cordis runtime and native ESM loading; panel ownership and deterministic disposal; typed service/event registry; settings and plugin manager with explicit trust warning; then real terminal, agent-chat, file-browser, and Git plugins.

nodes.label: No Test-Only Feature Plugins
nodes.rationale: Do not create test-only feature plugins. Early plugins should implement real basic functionality.

nodes.label: Plugin-First Desktop Workspace
nodes.rationale: Users choose which panels to open and arrange them with nested horizontal/vertical splits, tabs, drag/drop, and resizing.
